scenes.name: WHAT THE COUNT MEANS
lines: On November 27, nine standalone AI employee roles covered 102 of 120 workflows. That is 85 percent.
11 月 27 日，九个独立 AI 员工岗位覆盖 120 项流程中的 102 项，即 85.0%。
Count just the six core roles and the denominator changes. Eighty-two of ninety-nine, or 82.8 percent.
只看六个核心岗位，分母随之改变：99 项中覆盖 82 项，即 82.8%。

scenes.name: READ THE AUDIT
lines: Read down the core roster. Donna, Finance, Auto-X, Community, HR, Admin. Each bar counts workflows with evidence.
依次看六个核心岗位：Donna、财务、Auto-X、社群、人事、行政。每条实线都对应有证据的流程。
HR fell from fifteen of twenty to fourteen. The PDF-reading step failed the stricter evidence check.
人事从 15/20 下调至 14/20。读取 PDF 这一步没有通过更严格的证据复核。
Add Sentiment Monitor, six of seven. Knowledge Base Maintainer, three of three. Role nine, Retrospective Analyst, eleven of eleven.
再加上舆情监测员 6/7、知识库维护员 3/3。第九个岗位复盘分析员覆盖 11/11。

scenes.name: THE MISSED STAGE
lines: At the November 27 full-flow rehearsal, eleven of twelve stages passed first try. Four human actions. Donna’s median response was twenty-nine seconds.
11 月 27 日全流程排练中，12 个环节有 11 个一次通过，人类执行了 4 次操作。Donna 的响应中位数为 29 秒。
The host’s question sheet stalled in the Lark queue for 65 minutes. A scheduled one-shot task delivered it in three minutes.
主持人提问单在 Lark 队列卡了 65 分钟，改用一次性定时任务，3 分钟后送达。
External paying merchants at the audit date? Zero. That is where the first pilot starts.
截至审计日，外部付费商户有几家？零家。首批试点从这里开始。
